info.name: MuleSoft 3PL Onboarding — Azure Logic Apps
info.description:
All operations for the MuleSoft 3PL Onboarding Azure Logic App workflows.

Steps covered:
  Step 6 — mule-branch  : Create / get / list / delete GitHub feature branch
  Step 7 — yaml-patch   : Patch app/dev/tst/prod YAMLs + optional GitHub commit
  Step 8 — translation  : Generate Excel + CSV translation table
  Step 9 — mule-pr      : Create / get / list / merge GitHub PR + Teams notification
  Step 10 — manual      : SharePoint import + PR review (recorded in response)

Entry points:
  • Via dispatcher (recommended): POST {{dispatcherUrl}}
  • Direct sub-workflow:          POST {{baseUrl}}/api/{workflow}/triggers/manual/invoke?api-version={{apiVersion}}

Set the collection variables before running.

variable.description: Logic App Standard base URL (no trailing slash)
Main dispatcher trigger URL — primary entry point for all operations
Deployed 3pl-automation web app base URL (used by yaml-patch and translation)
GitHub Personal Access Token with repo scope
GitHub organisation or user that owns the MuleSoft config repo
Base branch to create feature branches from
Feature branch name (auto-generated by orchestrator if omitted)
PR number — used by Get PR and Merge PR requests
Teams incoming webhook URL for PR creation notifications
Path to app.yaml in the MuleSoft repo
Path to dev.yaml in the MuleSoft repo
Path to tst.yaml in the MuleSoft repo
Path to prod.yaml in the MuleSoft repo

item.name: 1 — Full Onboarding (Orchestrator)
item.description: End-to-end 3PL onboarding: creates feature branch (Step 6), patches YAMLs (Step 7), generates translation table (Step 8), creates PR + notifies Teams (Step 9).

item.name: Full Onboarding — With GitHub (Branch + YAML Commit + PR)
Full Onboarding — YAML Patch + Translation Only (No GitHub)
2 — Branch Management (Step 6)
item.description: Create, get, list, or delete a MuleSoft feature branch via the dispatcher (resource: mule-branch).

item.name: 3 — YAML Patch (Step 7)
item.description: Patch app/dev/tst/prod YAML files via the 3pl-automation web app. Optionally commit patched files to GitHub.

item.name: Patch YAMLs — Download Only (No GitHub Commit)
Patch YAMLs + Commit to GitHub Branch
4 — Translation Table (Step 8)
item.description: Generate Excel and CSV translation table from the onboardingInput.translation config.

item.name: 5 — PR Management (Step 9)
item.description: Create, get, list, or merge a GitHub pull request. Create also requests reviewers and optionally sends a Teams notification.

item.name: 6 — Direct Sub-Workflow Calls
item.description: Call each sub-workflow's HTTP trigger directly (bypassing the dispatcher). Useful for debugging individual steps or when the dispatcher URL is not yet configured.
